metaTitle: Audio Extractor - MP3 or WAV from Video (Free) | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Pull the audio out of a video or trim an audio file, preview it and save WAV or MP3. Everything runs in your browser.
ogTitle: Audio Extractor - Sound from Any Video
ogDescription: Extract or trim audio and download it as WAV or MP3 without uploading the file.
ldDescription: Extract the audio track from a video or trim an audio file, then export it as WAV or MP3 in the browser.
lede: Load a video or audio file, keep the part you need and download the result as WAV or MP3. The browser decodes and encodes it locally.

faq.a: Anything the browser can decode: MP4, MOV and WebM videos, plus MP3, WAV, M4A and OGG audio. A rare codec may be refused - the tool then names the file instead of failing silently.
WAV is lossless and bigger; MP3 is about a tenth of the size at 128 kbps and is the right choice for most uploads.
Yes. Set a start and end time and only that part is exported. Leave the fields empty to keep the whole file.
